n0076b993c4.headline: Qatar’s Emir Replaces Prime Minister With Close Aide
n0076b993c4.summary: Qatar's ruler appointed a close aide as the new prime minister following the resignation of Abdullah bin Nasser Al Thani, who had held the post since the emir came to power.
n0076b993c4.why: Qatar is a major global LNG exporter and sovereign wealth investor, so changes in its top government leadership can matter for energy and investment policy.

n4fc24c194f.summary: South African mining companies plan to build 609MW of electricity generating capacity, but they need official approval for the projects.
n4fc24c194f.why: South Africa has faced chronic power shortages, and mining is a major industry whose electricity supply depends on grid capacity and licensing.

ne9da68de52.summary: South African financial markets were hit by the global fallout from the spread of the Chinese coronavirus. The JSE had its biggest drop in eight months and the rand fell to a six-week low.
ne9da68de52.why: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange is South Africa's main equity market, and the rand is the country's currency, so both are sensitive to global risk sentiment.
